description: This file defines the GrainCollectionOptions class, which specifies configuration options for idle grain collection in Orleans, including timing parameters, memory pressure handling, and class-specific collection settings.

classes.name: GrainCollectionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for managing idle grain collection, deactivation timeouts, memory pressure shedding, and class-specific collection age policies.

methods.name: CollectionQuantum
methods.description: Gets or sets the quantum duration for periodic collection of inactive grains.

methods.name: CollectionAge
methods.description: Gets or sets the period of inactivity needed before a grain is considered for collection and deactivation.

methods.name: ClassSpecificCollectionAge
methods.description: Dictionary mapping grain classes to specific collection age durations.

methods.name: ActivationTimeout
methods.description: Timeout duration for attempting to activate a grain.

methods.name: DeactivationTimeout
methods.description: Timeout duration for deactivating a grain activation, including stopping timers and calling Grain.OnDeactivate().

methods.name: EnableActivationSheddingOnMemoryPressure
methods.description: Flag indicating whether grain activation shedding should occur under memory pressure conditions.

methods.name: MemoryUsagePollingPeriod
methods.description: Interval at which memory usage is polled to determine if shedding or collection is needed.

methods.name: MemoryUsageLimitPercentage
methods.description: Memory usage percentage threshold (0-100) at which grain collection is triggered.

methods.name: MemoryUsageTargetPercentage
methods.description: Target memory usage percentage after collection, less than or equal to MemoryUsageLimitPercentage.
